source_reconciliation.history_authority: #/history/primary (inventory); raw retained available rows beyond mirror, not observed contents

primary.meaning: Every available persisted normalized session/imported aggregate is candidate history, including pre-mirror ranges. No live store opened; contents/completeness/readability not asserted. No raw-usage age pruning identified in inspected tracker/history; imported-day replacement distinct; full retention audit remains required.

mirror.behavior: Daily/app/hour summary; active hint augmentation, atomic write, attempted POSIX0600. Not lossless archive; window never limits intended complete available donor backfill. SQLite rollups split duration across hours but count a session only in its start hour. The mirror accepts rollup rows only when totalSeconds>0 AND sessionCount>0, dropping positive-duration continuation hours with no same-app session start. A lone synthetic 09:30–10:30 session therefore loses its 10:00–10:30 continuation from the mirror; cross-midnight continuation is likewise dropped unless another same-app/hour start contributes sessionCount. Raw fallback instead assigns whole duration by start day/hour. Neither mirror path qualifies faithful per-hour/day history; raw persisted sessions remain source authority.

continuation_loss_evidence.literal: CASE WHEN ABS(bucket_start_jd - start_bucket_jd) < 0.0000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_count
continuation_loss_evidence.meaning: Continuation portions carry positive duration with zero session count.
Grouped rollup query passes summed duration and session count through.

continuation_loss_evidence.literal: for row in rows where row.totalSeconds > 0 && row.sessionCount > 0
continuation_loss_evidence.meaning: Mirror discards continuation-only positive duration rows.

collector.acquisition: NSWorkspace activation/frontmostApplication bundle ID fallback localizedName; screen sleep/wake/system sleep/wake/session resign/become-active delimit sessions. No active historical knowledgeC reader demonstrated.
states: switch while active finalizes old/seeds next
collector.loss: duration<2 seconds discarded including negative clock duration; pre-install/app-off/crash-unflushed/denied/missing/deleted records cannot be reconstructed. Future capture must retain observed short sessions.
collector.clock: Date wall-clock duration Double; start_time local yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss without offset, whole-second text; source_timestamp epoch Double retains finer start precision. No monotonic reconciliation/event sequence; clock/DST/timezone uncertainty preserved, not repaired by invented precision.
collector.commit: NSLock in-memory transitions; independent global utility async writes/hint changes can reorder. SQLite READWRITE|FULLMUTEX, busy_timeout5000, INSERT OR IGNORE; no capture journal/checkpoint/fsync ack or ignored-versus-new-row distinction.
collector.device_event_gap: OS state notifications delimit sessions; no complete separate durable device-event ledger demonstrated.

hint.behavior: Atomic best-effort async live hint, CLI augments some queries; not completed durable history. Wake seeds tracker without corresponding hint write.

identity.tracker_device: IOPlatformUUID via IOKit; fallback UUID per call not stable installation. Host/model/OS getters exist, not called here.
identity.sync_installation: UserDefaults timeMdCloudSyncDeviceId persists macos-UUID, distinct from hardware identity.
identity.record: Autoincrement usage.id, snapshot macos-row-ID scoped to installation; not globally immutable event identity. Preserve aliases/lineage without collapsing devices.
identity.legacy: Cloudkit metadata-hash backfilled transport/platform/day/entry; unknown origin remains unknown; iOS aggregates never exact sessions.

dedup.order: Snapshot start_time ASC,id ASC; CLI sessions start_time DESC lacks ID tie-breaker. Direct observation suppresses overlapping legacy same-app/media rows; nonoverlap retained. Source kind/device must remain separate.
dedup.rollups: usage_hourly_app_rollups/usage_rollup_meta backfilled_v2/triggers; all/direct scopes; first-hour session count.
